scope: All 35 assigned new PoolB bodies: main-thread PC24 arithmetic/helper-composition audit plus address/class duplicate audit. No games, host wiring, or broad tests.

precision_contract.main_thread: Post-D3D-device main thread PC24, round-to-nearest, exceptions masked. Existing inline x87 continues to inherit the caller control word; no global control-word mutation introduced.
precision_contract.other_threads: Worker and pre-device main-thread PC53 are distinct contracts; this audit does not claim all gameplay runs at PC24.
precision_contract.compiler: Existing /fp:strict for bsp_core (CMakeLists.txt:266) and bsp_game (cmake/startup.cmake:512); established SSE2 float intermediates. The audit found no unrounded assigned C++ float/double arithmetic chain to repair.
precision_contract.idiom: For C++ x87 models, established pc24(double single_operation)->float or strict per-op float intermediates are appropriate. Existing inline x87 preserves arithmetic and store ordering directly here.
precision_contract.crt: Native _ftol2, Lua numerical conversion, formatting and all transcendental internals retain their explicit binding domains. CRT transcendental temporary PC53 must not be flattened into PC24; none is reconstructed by these changes.
